core_obligations: For any elementary etale neighbourhood (U, u) -> (X, x), form the groupoid (U x_X x, R); the quotient U x_X x/R is an algebraic space with one point over x.
Refinements U' -> U of elementary etale neighbourhoods give morphisms of the quotients.
The system is directed: for two neighbourhoods of (X, x), a common refinement exists.
The final object is the quotient of the groupoid (X x_X x, R) of the identity neighbourhood.
proof_roadmap: Quotient per neighbourhood; functoriality under refinement; directedness; final quotient.
difficulty_reason: A structural lemma building the neighbourhood category; the directedness and final-object checks are short but genuine.
